title: Build a retrieval agent
subtitle: Create, test, publish and add Outlook email in Copilot Studio.

steps.title: Create the new agent
steps.evidence: Create a new agent in the new experience, then provide its name, image and instructions.

steps.title: Add knowledge sources
steps.evidence: The agent can use public websites, files, SharePoint, Dataverse and Azure AI Search.

steps.title: Select a model and test
steps.evidence: Add knowledge, select a model and test the agent.

steps.title: Publish the agent
steps.evidence: The agent can be published and extended with the Office 365 Outlook Send an email (V2) tool

steps.title: Add Outlook email action
steps.evidence: Add the Office 365 Outlook Send an email (V2) tool and authenticate its connector if needed.
